Hi! I'm Daniel - feel free to browse the content and contact me for any question
or comments.

This website primarily hosts small blog-styled pieces of statistical material I
want to share - with friends, colleagues, and future me. Please go the [blog
posts](/blog/index.qmd) or reach out to [me](/about.qmd) if you have any
comments or questions.

All content is MIT License so feel free to reuse or build upon it --- but I
encourage you to keep it open source.

Content is written by me (not AI) and there will be typos and potential for
errors. Also, content will be opinionated.
